items.title: 67802_Charles Mingus oral history interview
items.q: [MS. MINGUS] Philip? (Inaudible.) John Scofield. [INTERVIEWEE] Anyway, I (unintelligible) he and Larry on a complete different style. Really accomplished players.

ctx.x: Who was the other guitar player on Three or Four Shades of Blues?
Yeah, John Scofield, I remember his name from the record.
